author: cli
text:
Re-read after the cluster-label work. The docstring still describes this exactly: it loads the whole emitted page and runs it, and it remains the only thing that catches a fatal renderer error - the TDZ blank canvas and the 'draw is not defined' scope bug are both still the reason it exists.

Changed here: the recording context stub answers measureText with a real TextMetrics shape. Without it this test failed on the cluster labels, which read .width - a FALSE failure, since every browser 2d context has measureText. Worth keeping in mind for this probe specifically: it asserts 'the page threw', so any gap in the stub reads as a product defect rather than a harness one, and that asymmetry costs a diagnosis every time.
